newsitem.title: USA: D&P downgrades Western Atlas debt rating.
newsitem.headline: D&P downgrades Western Atlas debt rating.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Friday it had downgraded the senior debt of Western Atlas Inc to triple-B-plus from single-A-minus.
In May Duff said it might downgrade Western Atlas after the company said it planned to spin off its industrial automation segment.
About $400 million in senior debt is affected by this action.
Duff said it also initiated rating coverage of Western Atlas's pending $400 million commercial paper program at D-2.

"Following the spin-off of its industrial automation businesses, Western Atlas becomes a focused oilfield services company with leading market positions in the seismic and wireline sectors," Duff said. "These market positions should allow the company to benefit from the strong fundamentals currently existing for oilfield services suppliers while buffering the company's results in cyclical downturns."
Duff said Western Atlas is expected to retain the bulk of its current debt and, as a result, will "exhibit somewhat weakened quantitative credit protection measures following the spin-off."
